queries: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), a AS (SELECT c.cnt, s.avg_cnt, s.total FROM c, s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_above, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM a

WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL college_id form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Players with a NULL player_id are not counted by COUNT(DISTINCT).
The total in (2) is the sum of per-college distinct-player counts, so a player attending several colleges counts once in each. It is not the number of distinct players overall.
